messages:
emily: Customer hit a GitHub SSO failure during signup. They click \"Sign in with GitHub\" and end up with a 403 on our callback. Error from app: \"state mismatch\". They pasted the callback URL they received: /auth/github/callback?code=O2...&state=Y2hhbGxlbmdlKzE=.

emily: Repro steps from customer: open signin -> redirected to github -> approve -> redirected back to /auth/github/callback -> 403. Happens in Chrome and Safari. They say it was working earlier today.

support-bot: ticket #SUP-12412 opened and customer notified.

sam: @emily can you grab the proxy/access logs for the callback request? need the full query string and the cookie/session that shows the original state we saved. also which GH app (org or user) and redirect URI configured in the GH app settings.

emily: Pasted logs below (redacted):

```
[2026-09-12T15:04:32Z] "GET /auth/github/callback?code=O2...&state=Y2hhbGxlbmdlKzE= HTTP/1.1" 403 234 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
Session cookie: s=eyJzdGF0ZSI6IllpV0... (base64url)
Saved state in session (decoded): YiW...+1
Callback state param (as received in logs, decoded): YiW... 1   <-- note: plus sign turned into space here
```

sam: interesting — the saved state contains a `+` near the end, but the request log shows a space where the `+` should be. that would cause our equality check to fail. looks like some component is converting `+` to space in the query string.

sam: possible culprits: client not encoding `+` (should be %2B), a redirect rewriting step, or our ingress normalizing the query. can you repro locally by triggering the same flow and capturing the raw redirect from GitHub?

emily: repro steps I used:

1) start login from app: GET https://app.staging.example.com/login -> redirected to https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&state=YiW...+1&code_challenge=...
2) approve on GH -> GH redirects back to https://app.staging.example.com/auth/github/callback?code=abc123&state=YiW...+1
3) our app returns 403 because req.query.state != session.state

I tried the same flow but intercepted the redirect using a minimal curl-based redirect catcher: 

```
curl -v "https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&state=YiW...+1" -L
# then watch the Location header that goes back to our callback
```

emily: when I hit our ingress directly (bypassing CDN) the location header preserves the `+`. when the CDN is in front, the logged callback has a space.

sam: that nails it — CDN or edge is normalizing `+` in query strings. + is special in application/x-www-form-urlencoded where `+` is decoded to space. some proxies decode then re-encode incorrectly.

sam: immediate mitigation options:
- short-term: change our state encoding to base64url WITHOUT padding and avoid `+` and `/` characters (use - and _).
- short-term 2: ensure client uses encodeURIComponent on state so `+` becomes %2B.
- medium-term: config change on CDN/ingress to preserve raw query string (don't decode+reencode).

emily: customer wants a fix ASAP. they can try clearing CDN cache or use non-CDN domain but prefer a fix on our side.

sam: I can push a tiny middleware to normalize state before comparison: replace(/\s/g,'+') on received state. that would accept the malformed space but feels like masking the root cause. prefer to fix at edge + change encoding.

david: can we do both? quick middleware deploy as fallback + edge config change. I'll take the edge ticket. @deploy-bot can you roll a small ingress config change to stop query normalization for auth routes?

deploy-bot: Starting rollout 2fa8c9: set preserve_query true for /auth/* on edge pool. will route 5% -> 100% over 10m.

sam: also opened ENG-9783 to switch client state encoding to base64url-no-pad. will coordinate with web-ex for a patch.

deploy-bot: Rollout at 100% for preserve_query. No errors during rollout.

emily: customer re-tested and confirms SSO works now. they see the callback with `state=YiW...%2B1` preserved and our check passes.

sam: created quick middleware fallback in canary that treats spaces in state as `+` to avoid breaking users mid-rollout. patch deployed to canary only.

david: filing postmortem stub: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/SUP-12412. notes: outbound state encoding should be base64url-no-pad; CDN must preserve raw query. root cause: CDN decoded+re-encoded querystrings turning `+` -> space.

emily: marking ticket resolved. thanks all. :tada:

sam: follow-up: web-ex to land client change this week, eng-sre to add test against query normalization in CI for auth routes.

emily: closing thread.
